scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check . "!deploy/secrets/**" "!secrets/**" && depcruise apps packages --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs && pnpm lint:migrations && pnpm lint:unused
scripts.dev:up: sh deploy/dev/secrets.sh && docker compose -f deploy/compose.dev.yml up -d --build --wait db app && docker compose -f deploy/compose.dev.yml up -d --wait proxy && docker compose -f deploy/compose.dev.yml ps
scripts.dev:psql: docker compose -f deploy/compose.dev.yml exec db sh -c 'PGPASSWORD=$(cat /run/secrets/db_app_password) psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U tribo_app -d tribo'
scripts.dev:tribo: docker compose -f deploy/compose.dev.yml exec app node apps/server/dist/cli.js
scripts.dev:trust: docker compose -f deploy/compose.dev.yml cp proxy:/data/caddy/pki/authorities/local/root.crt deploy/secrets/dev/caddy-root.crt && echo 'Trust it with: sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain deploy/secrets/dev/caddy-root.crt'
